run.normalization: sklearn digits / 16, so the peak for PSNR is 1
run.psnr: psnr_from_mean_mse is 10 log10(1 / mean squared error) on the holdout. psnr_mean_of_images is the mean of per-image PSNRs and is not the number to quote: it explodes when some images are exact.
run.global_ssim: single window = the whole 8x8 image, N-1 variances, L=1. Not local-window SSIM.
run.codec_quality: PSNR/SSIM are computed from unpack(pack(packet)), scales stored as float32

control_packet_gap.note: The RES-201 packet stores layer 0 Ub and Vb only. Ub @ Vb is not the residual-stack reconstruction. The studio packet's decode matches the engine reconstruction.
